Tom H: Quick Q  manager wants promo effective 2026-09-01. What's the last day to submit so payroll shows new base on that date? @Ivy (People Ops)
Ivy (People Ops): Hi @Tom H  submit by 2026-08-18 EOD PT to guarantee payroll update for 2026-09-01. Need manager rec, role profile, evidence, proposed comp, and manager 2-up.
Tom H: If we miss cutoff can we still retro to 09/01?
Rosa (People Ops): Yes, we can apply retro back to requested effective date if approvals happen within 90 days. Retro >60 days needs finance sign-off.
Eli (Finance): Confirming Rosa. Retro >60 days requires finance review and will usually process in the next payroll after approval. Use payroll code PROMO-RETRO.
Tom H: Manager asked about topping of band  can we do a market adjustment or split equity instead of base bump?
Ivy (People Ops): Options: phased base increase, one-time market adjustment (taxed as bonus), or equity refresh (grants team sign-off). Budget owner must approve non-base comp.
Tom H: Any special handling for IC->mgr conversions?
Rosa (People Ops): IC->Manager needs leadership calibration, 2-up sign-off, and direct-reports list. Expect ~5-7 extra business days. Submit earlier if you need a tight date.
comp-bot: Promo packet created by Tom H  status: metadata logged. Calibration window tentative: 2026-08-20 to 2026-08-22.
Tom H: Thanks  I'll get it in by 08/15 to be safe.
